Class ThermodynamicMetricsHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.metrics.ThermodynamicMetricsHelper
public final class ThermodynamicMetricsHelper extends Object

ThermodynamicMetricsHelper

Calculates macroscopic thermodynamic, bioenergetic, and physical exergy metrics for the planetary civilization engine (Leslie White's law, Vaclav Smil exergy transitions, EROI, trophic multiplier, and Kardashev scale).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • getEnergyCaptured

      public double getEnergyCaptured()
      Evaluates total power captured by human civilization in Megawatts ($\text{MW}$) according to Vaclav Smil's (2017) exergy transitions and Leslie White's Energy Law: $$P_{\text{cap}} = \sum_i P_{i, \text{watts}} \times N_i / 10^6$$

      Evaluates directly from first-order physical cellular buffers (power dissipation in Watts/capita and population per cell) in strict compliance with AGENTS.md Â§10.4, eliminating circular dependencies with emergent technological diagnostics.

      Returns:
      total captured power in $\text{MW}$

      public double getEroiAlimentaire()
      Evaluates Energy Return on Investment for the food/subsistence system ($\text{EROI}_{\text{alim}} = E_{\text{out}} / E_{\text{in}}$) using an authentic continuous inverse logistic response (Boserup 1965; Hall et al. 2014; Giampietro 2013).

    • getNetSurplusFraction

      public double getNetSurplusFraction()
      Evaluates net societal energy surplus fraction $\Phi = 1 - 1 / \text{EROI}_{\text{alim}}$ (Tainter 1988, Hall et al. 2014).
